name: CommandMenu
description:
A command palette card: a search field with a ⌘K hint, grouped commands with icons and keyboard shortcuts, and a footer of key hints - composed from Input, Kbd, Navigation and Icon.

  CommandMenu do
    CommandGroup(label: "Suggestions") do
      CommandItem(icon: :layout_dashboard, shortcut: %w[ G D ], href: dashboard_path) { "Open dashboard" }
      CommandItem(icon: :user_plus, shortcut: %w[ ⌘ I ], value: "invite") { "Invite teammates" }
    end
  end

Typing filters the commands; ↑ / ↓ move the highlight and ↵ runs it (follows its `href:` or clicks it); ⌘K / Ctrl+K focuses the search from anywhere. Choosing a command emits `blocks--command-menu:select` with { value }. Strings: command_menu.locales.yml.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes Blocks (e.g. `CommandMenu(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

CommandGroup.description: A labelled group of CommandItems in a CommandMenu; hidden while none of its items match.

CommandItem.description:
A command in a CommandMenu: an icon, the label and its keyboard shortcut. With `href:` it's a link, otherwise a button whose `value:` comes with `blocks--command-menu:select`.

  CommandItem(icon: :rocket, shortcut: %w[ ⇧ D ], value: "deploy") { "Deploy to production" }

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes:
The Appica homepage card. Type to filter, ↑ / ↓ to move, ↵ to run; ⌘K / Ctrl+K focuses the
search. The chosen command is shown below.

examples.name: Links
examples.notes: Commands with `href:` are links; ↵ follows the highlighted one.

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes: Rendered in Arabic whatever the toolbar says.
examples.code:
phlex do
  I18n.with_locale(:ar) do
    div(dir: "rtl") do
      CommandMenu(class: "w-95 max-w-full") do
        CommandGroup(label: "اقتراحات") do
          CommandItem(icon: :layout_dashboard, shortcut: %w[ G D ]) { "فتح لوحة التحكم" }
          CommandItem(icon: :user_plus, shortcut: %w[ ⌘ I ]) { "دعوة زملاء الفريق" }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
